metadata.name: M. balthica shell length and frequency measurements from Rönnebank (Baltic Sea) – June 2023
metadata.description: Dataset of 36 records collected during Expedition EMB320 at Rönnebank (Baltic Sea) in June 2023. Columns include constant values (Expedition = EMB320, Location = Rönnebank (Baltic Sea), Sampling date = June 2023), a balanced two‑level categorical factor "Site" (18 records each), shell length (mm) and shell‑frequency counts for the bivalve abbreviated as "M. balthica". No missing values are present. (based on get_field_statistics and get_resource_info)
metadata.spatial: approx. 1° latitude steps; longitude spacing variable across a 0–167° range (derived from the numeric range of the possible coordinate pair, which may not represent true geographic coordinates) (based on get_spatial_extent and detect_spatial_columns)
metadata.temporal: source granularity month (June 2023); parsed timestamps have sub‑second precision (based on analyze_temporal_column and get_temporal_extent)
